outcomes.text: I kept the promise when it had stopped being exciting. Somebody noticed.
I tried to follow through, but the circumstances had changed. It still took effort.
I explained what had changed. We found a smaller version that still mattered.
They heard an excuse where I meant an explanation.
I let that chapter close. Relief and regret arrived together.
The chance went to somebody else. I was more disappointed than I expected.
